bio: Vintage black and white photos, the father-in-law’s old bicycle and a Berkel meat slicer offset this restaurant’s elegant, fresh interior. De Ceder has been a blue-ribbon establishment in the area for some 40 years now. The chef knows all the classics of Franco-Belgian cuisine and often whips things up at the last minute, as is demonstrated by his steak with a subtle pepper sauce and fresh fries. He’s also keen on full-bodied oriental spices and Asian notes. We warrant you will adore the attractive wine list and, why not, even treat yourself to a night in the B&B…...
